title: Monitoring Primer
scenario: Welcome to Monitoring Primer. Before proceeding, you must master these essential networking terms. IP Flow Information Export (IPFIX): IETF standard (RFC 7011) for exporting IP flow data. Successor to Cisco NetFlow v9. Sends flow records to a collector on UDP 4739 (or 2055 for NetFlow compatibility). Switched Port Analyzer (SPAN): Port mirroring — copies traffic from source port(s) or VLAN to a monitor port for analysis (IDS/packet capture). Local to one switch. RSPAN extends mirroring across multiple switches.
